summary: Steep residential kerb with several cars parked; houses 21-24 m away mid-block.

best_section.where: North kerb mid-block, between the two houses with side gardens

drivers.seclusion: Houses 21-24 m back mid-block, but 10-13 m at both ends; homes opposite too.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street with cars parked here; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street; junction with a main road at the west end.
drivers.convention: Several cars park on this kerb, so a van would blend in.

sun_shade: Trees on the north side give shade from the north and west; open to the east.
